verdict.rationale: 1Password is a password and secrets manager, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The evidence shows only the opposite role: 1Password publishes its own MCP servers (the Environments MCP Server and a public docs MCP) for external clients such as Claude Code and Cursor. Serving tools does not make this client-side axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
